notes: A fourth zone after the storm: the Still Hollow, a cave of hanging stone and still water, not more forest
A kindled press plants a lantern; a gold thread runs to the next cold ring, and lit lamps keep a road of light
Still water holds and sinks you until a planted lantern or its road stills that pool; shadows on the road wash into light
Five lanterns open a crystal heart; the ending is those lamps standing in a dawn
The first three stages are still the forest; ?glow-start=4 skips to the hollow
